subject.title: feat: adopt shared OpenClaw design system palette

question: When should this stacked palette migration be allowed to leave draft given the private @openclaw/design-system dependency and global visual impact?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the safe merge point depends on package distribution and visual approval decisions that automation cannot make.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Package Access Works
options.body: Leave this PR draft until the base install stack can install in hosted CI/Vercel and the claimed route screenshots are attached or otherwise inspectable.

options.title: Accept With Operator-Owned Credentialing
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers explicitly choose to operate cross-repository package credentials and verify hosted build/deploy behavior before release.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: If the design-system package will remain private without a consumer credential path, pause or close the stack and reopen when packaging is settled.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft Until Package Access Works
recommendation.body: Leave this PR draft until the base install stack can install in hosted CI/Vercel and the claimed route screenshots are attached or otherwise inspectable.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current theme implementation history and authored the design-system stack carrying the dependency decision.
